title: CompTIA Cloud+ (CV0-004) Study Guide
description: CompTIA Cloud+ is the vendor-neutral cloud operations certification. The CV0-004 exam is up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, mixing multiple choice with performance-based tasks, and needs 750 on a 100–900 scale to pass. It covers architecture, deployment, operations, security and troubleshooting across cloud environments generally rather than one provider's console — the material assumes you are running workloads in production, not evaluating a platform.
audience: Systems administrators and infrastructure engineers moving into cloud operations, and anyone supporting workloads across more than one provider. CompTIA recommends two to three years of hands-on experience as a systems administrator or cloud engineer. It assumes you already understand networking and systems administration — it does not teach either, and the exam is noticeably harder without them.
why_get_it: Cloud+ is the cloud cert that isn't locked to one provider. Where AWS and Azure certifications prove you know a specific platform, Cloud+ proves you understand cloud operations as a discipline—architecture, deployment, security, automation, and troubleshooting that transfer across providers. That's valuable for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, which most enterprises now run. CV0-004 was rebuilt to include DevOps and automation fundamentals, reflecting how cloud is actually operated today. For sysadmins and infrastructure engineers moving into cloud roles, it validates the operational breadth employers need.
when_to_get_it: Cloud+ makes sense once you have Network+ level networking and real systems-administration experience, and your work is drifting toward cloud operations. It is most useful alongside a provider certification rather than instead of one: AWS or Azure proves you know a platform, Cloud+ proves you understand the operational patterns that survive a move between them. If you only ever touch one cloud, take that vendor's associate certification first. If you support a mixed estate, or your employer wants something vendor-neutral, this is the one that fits.
exam_format: Up to 90 questions: multiple choice and performance-based. Passing score: 750 (on a scale of 100–900).
recertification_note: Valid for 3 years. Renew through CompTIA's Continuing Education (CE) program by earning CEUs, or by passing a higher-level CompTIA exam.
salary_note: Cloud roles are among the best-paid in IT. Cloud-focused systems and infrastructure engineers commonly earn $90K–$120K early on, with experienced cloud engineers reaching $130K–$150K+ and specialists going higher. Cloud+ is most valuable stacked with hands-on platform experience (AWS/Azure) and automation skills, which push compensation toward the top of the range.

items: Cloud service and deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS; public, private, hybrid)
Designing for high availability, scalability, and elasticity
Compute, storage, and network resource planning
Provisioning compute, storage, and networking resources
Identity, access control, and least privilege in the cloud
Data security, encryption, and key management
Network security: segmentation, firewalls, and security groups
Troubleshooting connectivity, capacity, and deployment issues

study_steps.title: Download the CV0-004 exam objectives
study_steps.description: Get the official Cloud+ CV0-004 objectives from CompTIA. The blueprint spans architecture, deployment, security, operations, and DevOps—use it to structure your study and find gaps.

study_steps.title: Confirm your networking and sysadmin base
study_steps.description: Cloud+ assumes networking (Network+ level) and systems-administration fundamentals. If subnetting, DNS, firewalls, or basic Linux/Windows admin are shaky, shore those up first—cloud builds on them.

study_steps.title: Work through a primary video course
study_steps.description: Choose one comprehensive CV0-004 course and complete it end to end. An all-in-one Cloud+ course on Udemy covers every domain with demos. See the paid resources section.

study_steps.title: Read the official study guide
study_steps.description: The Sybex Cloud+ Study Guide (CV0-004) by Ben Piper is the standard written reference. Use it to deepen the architecture and security domains, which reward conceptual clarity.

study_steps.title: Get hands-on in a real cloud
study_steps.description: Spin up free-tier resources on AWS or Azure: deploy a VM, configure a virtual network and security group, set up monitoring. Cloud+ is provider-neutral, but real reps in any cloud make the concepts concrete.

study_steps.title: Practice the operational scenarios
study_steps.description: Cloud+ leans on troubleshooting and operations. Drill scenarios: a deployment fails, capacity runs out, a resource is unreachable. Practice reasoning to the root cause—the PBQs test exactly this.

study_steps.title: Take timed practice exams
study_steps.description: Use full-length CV0-004 practice exams. Aim to score consistently above 85% before booking. Review every miss and re-study the weak domain.

study_steps.title: Schedule and sit the exam
study_steps.description: Register through Pearson VUE for the 90-minute exam (test center or online proctored). Book about two weeks out to set a deadline and keep your prep focused.

faq.question: Is CompTIA Cloud+ worth it?
faq.answer: For multi-cloud and hybrid operations roles, yes. Cloud+ proves vendor-neutral cloud operations skills that transfer across AWS, Azure, and others. It's most valuable paired with hands-on platform experience and a provider-specific cert.

faq.question: Cloud+ vs AWS Solutions Architect — which should I get?
faq.answer: They serve different goals. AWS SAA proves deep skill on one platform and is in higher demand by name. Cloud+ proves broad, vendor-neutral cloud operations knowledge. Many people get both: a provider cert for depth, Cloud+ for breadth.

faq.question: Do I need experience before Cloud+?
faq.answer: No formal prerequisite, but CompTIA recommends networking and systems-administration knowledge (Network+ level) plus some cloud or data-center experience. Hands-on time in any cloud makes the exam much easier.

faq.question: What is the passing score for Cloud+?
faq.answer: 750 on a scale of 100 to 900. CompTIA uses scaled scoring, so there is no fixed number of questions you have to get right — harder questions carry more weight, and the raw-to-scaled conversion is not published.

faq.question: How hard is the CV0-004 exam?
faq.answer: It's an intermediate exam covering broad ground—architecture, deployment, security, operations, and DevOps. The breadth is the challenge. Performance-based questions test troubleshooting and operational reasoning, so hands-on practice is important.

faq.question: How long does it take to study for Cloud+?
faq.answer: Most candidates spend 2 to 4 months part-time. Those with existing cloud or sysadmin experience may move faster. Budget time for hands-on labs, not just video courses.

faq.question: What comes after Cloud+?
faq.answer: Common next steps include provider-specific certs (AWS, Azure), or deeper specializations in cloud security and DevOps. Cloud+ pairs naturally with an AWS or Azure associate certification.

faq.question: Does Cloud+ expire?
faq.answer: Yes. Cloud+ is valid for three years. Renew through CompTIA's Continuing Education program by earning CEUs or passing a higher-level CompTIA exam.
